name: @battleplan/chat
description: Chat Lambda that mediates questions and answers with Cursor cloud agents.

scripts.test:local: vitest run --config ../vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --reporter=verbose chat && terraform -chdir=terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=terraform validate
scripts.test:agent: vitest run --config ../vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --reporter=junit --outputFile=../test-results/chat-agent.xml chat && terraform -chdir=terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=terraform validate
